details.what_it_does: Superhuman began as a fast, AI-powered email app and is now a suite that includes Superhuman Mail, Grammarly, Docs and an AI agent called Go. Superhuman Mail helps you write replies with AI, sort your inbox and save time on email.
details.who_its_for: Busy professionals who live in their inbox and want to process email faster.
pros: Free tier for the AI assistant tools
cons: The Mail app itself requires the Business plan
Expensive compared with free email apps
Takes time to learn the shortcuts
